Title: Public preview: Azure Compute Gallery feature ‘community gallery’

Body.Content:
Share private VM images with the broader Azure community using Azure Compute Gallery. With community gallery, you can now create a gallery and share the images it contains with other Azure customers. As a result, Azure customers can deploy VMs and VM scale sets via the Portal, CLI, and RestAPI using the images you published.

Sign up to request access to the preview and begin publishing images within the Azure community.

Learn more.
